name: Arman Holdings Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Arman Holdings Ltd deals in Textile Products, Precious Metal & Stones, and Plastic & related products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
AHL is in the business of trading and importing of:
a) Industrial & Raw Materials:
Chemicals, Cement, Plastic, Oil, Ferrous, and non-ferrous metals
b) Textiles & Natural Goods:
Textiles, Jute, Tea
c) Paper & Consumables:
Paper, Consumable articles,General goods and stores
d) Automotive & Electronics:
Automobiles, Electronic and electrical goods
e) Precious Commodities:
Gold, Diamonds, metals,and Precious stones
f) General Merchandise & Handicrafts:
Handicrafts, All other sorts of merchandise,
Chattels and effects of all kinds
g) Financial & Investment:
Loans and investments, Land, Shares, Debentures
h) Games and Toys **
i) Plastic products
j) Trading & Distribution:**
Wholesale and retail,Import and export,Buying, selling, exhibiting, and General dealing in goods

pros: Debtor days have improved from 256 to 177 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 7.15 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -2.10% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.11% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 177 days.
